key_risks: Rapid de-escalation or diplomatic resolution in Strait of Hormuz could reverse oil gains before July 21 close.
July 15 PPI and retail sales releases could shift rate-cut expectations and pressure energy rotation.
Profit-taking after recent sharp energy and oil moves may cap upside within the scoring window.

portfolio.rationale: Oil prices at multi-week highs after Hormuz blockade reimposed; unresolved military and shipping risks support further near-term gains in energy equities.
Direct crude exposure benefits from Brent/WTI surge to highest levels since mid-June amid ongoing Strait tensions likely to persist through the week.
Major banks posted record Q2 profits and strong consumer spending data; sector positioned for continued momentum into next week.

portfolio_rationale: Concentrated allocation to energy and oil captures the dominant short-term catalyst from elevated geopolitical oil-supply risk, supplemented by financials strength from recent earnings beats.
rationale_summary: One-week window dominated by unresolved Hormuz blockade and rising oil prices, with supportive bank earnings providing secondary tailwind; weak jobs data secondary to energy flow risks.
